title: Evaluations & ALQs
summary: The planner organizes Airman Leadership Qualities under four Major Graded Areas: Executing the Mission, Leading People, Managing Resources, and Improving the Unit. Use the accomplishment capture tool to document what you did, how you did it, and why the result mattered.
source: 2026 USAF Digital Planner; current evaluation guidance should be verified

title: Enlisted Promotions
summary: The planner includes WAPS and SNCO promotion cycle information, PECDs, public release dates, record-review reminders, and the Whole Person Concept. Testing windows and member-specific eligibility can change.
source: 2026 USAF Digital Planner; 36-2502; AFPC public promotion releases

title: Enlisted Development
summary: Use the Brown Book, Enlisted Force Structure, Blueprint, PME, education, mentorship, and deliberate development goals to plan growth beyond the next evaluation cycle.

title: Record Review
summary: Periodically review your records, decorations, career data, performance history, and promotion information. The planner emphasizes documenting performance and seeking feedback from senior enlisted leaders.
